name: browser-use
headline: Configure Claude Code with platform-ready setups
short_description: Claude-starter is a platform-agnostic framework for production-ready Claude Code configurations. It includes 40+ skills, meta-commands, and workflow automation tools. Operations teams use it to streamline AI integration across projects, reducing setup time and ensuring consistency.
author: raintree-technology

sections.overview:
Agent-starter is an opinionated multi-agent skill pack designed for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. It provides 29 deep, handwritten skills organized into specialized domains: HCI usability modeling and GOMS/KLM analysis, comprehensive Apple HIG guidance across platforms and components, copywriting frameworks, and code cleanup utilities for removing dead code, circular dependencies, and weak types. The framework generates agent-native project files from a shared skill source without requiring orchestration frameworks or YAML configuration. Teams use agent-starter to standardize AI agent integration across projects, accelerate setup time, and maintain consistency in how agents handle design reviews, code quality improvements, and documentation tasks.
Run Apple HIG audits on iOS/macOS projects with severity gates and exported reports
Estimate cognitive load and interaction costs in product workflows using GOMS/KLM analysis
Clean up legacy codebases by detecting dead code, circular dependencies, and duplicate logic
Generate copywriting for landing pages, emails, and CTAs using structured frameworks
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/raintree-technology/claude-starter`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
